scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd packages/backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.app:build: cd packages/frontend && VITE_BASE=./ npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap sync ios && git checkout -- android/build.gradle android/app/build.gradle android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties android/variables.gradle android/settings.gradle && sed -i '' 's/swift-tools-version: 5.9/swift-tools-version: 5.7/' ios/App/CapApp-SPM/Package.swift
